recommendation: Keep this source-changing reconciliation. It completes the Applied issue without changing unrelated PATCH behavior; future patch format additions should update ValueSet/patchmimetypes and the patchFormat comment together.
issue_request: FHIR-46193 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for FHIR-core Conformance. It requested constraining CapabilityStatement.patchFormat away from all MIME types to the five legal patch MIME types: application/fhir+xml, application/fhir+json, application/fhir+turtle, application/json-patch+json, and application/xml-patch+xml, and updating the comment that implied only JSON Patch and XML Patch were legal.
initial_application: Upstream commit d42017f27269949479aca292f2365ab8c804f560 partially applied the issue by adding ValueSet/patchmimetypes, adding a PatchMimeType row in source/terminologies/bindings.xml, and changing CapabilityStatement.patchFormat to reference ValueSet/patchmimetypes. The current source still had the old two-format comment and retained generic MimeType binding metadata that said any valid MIME type was allowed.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement is active in source/fhir.ini, making source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-CapabilityStatement.xml in build scope. source/terminologies/bindings.xml feeds standard binding metadata, and the checked-in capabilitystatement.svg displayed the stale all-MIME-types binding tooltip. FHIR-I minutes from 2024-06-24 confirm the 8-0-0 decision that a value set for the five suggested values was reasonable. No relevant Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Changed CapabilityStatement.patchFormat to use the PatchMimeType binding name, replaced the generic all-MIME-types binding definition with patch-specific text, updated the comment to enumerate all five legal patch MIME types, and synchronized the PatchMimeType binding row and checked-in SVG tooltip.
source_changes: source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-CapabilityStatement.xml: updated CapabilityStatement.patchFormat comment to list all five legal patch MIME types and changed the binding name/definition from generic MimeType to PatchMimeType.
source/terminologies/bindings.xml: aligned the PatchMimeType binding definition with patch-specific wording.
source/capabilitystatement/capabilitystatement.svg: synchronized the checked-in diagram tooltip for the PatchMimeTypes binding.
